claim: Triple E hotel sits at Avenue Louis Goblet 152, 7331 Saint-Ghislain (Baudour), directly across from the d'Eugénie à Émilie and Le Faitout restaurants, with limited parking on request.
quote: Avenue Louis Goblet 152, 7331 Saint-Ghislain ... just across from the restaurants 'd'Eugénie and Emilie' and 'du Faitout' ... limited parking available upon request.

claim: Triple E offers three rooms — Eugénie €190 (ground floor), Émilie €210 (1st floor with bath + shower), Éric €190 (2nd floor, two singles) — all with WiFi, TV, A/C, bathrobes.
quote: Eugénie €190/night ... Emilie €210/night ... Eric €190/night ... Douche, Wifi et télévision, Climatiseur, Lit double de 180, Peignoirs

claim: Breakfast at Triple E is served in 'Atmosphère de Pascale' from 8:00–10:30 for €30/person, with house-made breads, pastries, charcuterie and eggs.
quote: Pains et viennoiseries maisons, charcuteries, oeufs ... €30 per person ... 8am-10:30am

claim: D'Eugénie à Émilie is at Place de la Résistance 1, 7331 Baudour and officially recommends its affiliated Triple E hotel for guests staying overnight.
quote: Place de la Résistance 1, 7331 Baudour ... The restaurant operates an affiliated hotel called Triple E, which offers three comfortable guest rooms.

claim: D'Eugénie à Émilie holds two Michelin stars; chef Éric Fernez cooks with daughter Émilie front-of-house.
quote: Two Stars: Excellent cooking ... Éric Fernez inherited his love of cooking from his grand-mother, Eugénie, and he has passed on this passion to his daughter, Émilie.

claim: The restaurant reopened after a full renovation of building, kitchen and workshops and is now booked solid every service; reopening targeted end of February 2026.
quote: After months of work and a renovation that transformed into a complete transformation (brighter dining room and ultramodern workshops), the Michelin two-star restaurant 'D'Eugénie à Émilie' reopened its doors ... fully booked every day.

claim: TripAdvisor lists no hotel properties physically in Baudour; the nearest indexed options are all in adjacent communes 1.7–3.5 km away.
quote: There are no properties directly in Baudour. The following list shows nearby accommodations sorted by distance from Baudour center.

claim: Avenue Louis Goblet is a 0.37 km street that intersects Place de Baudour, putting Triple E within a few minutes' walk of Place de la Résistance.
quote: Avenue Louis Goblet ... length of 0.37 kilometres ... intersects with several connected streets including Rue Fosty, Rue d'Herchies, Rue Ferrer, Rue du Parc, Place de Baudour

claim: Cense de Lalouette (Rue de Tournai 188, 7333 Saint-Ghislain) is an 18th-century coaching inn with 3 apart-hotel units, 4.5/5 on TripAdvisor, $136–$233/night; ~3.4 km from Baudour (driving required).
quote: Rue de Tournai 188, Saint-Ghislain 7333, Belgium ... 4.5 out of 5 stars ... 3 fully equipped rental units restored with 'the charm of an 18th century inn.' ... $136-$233 per night

claim: MAH Hotel (Rue de la Verrerie 5, 7330 Saint-Ghislain) is a 3-star, 55-room hotel ~3.5 km from the restaurant with free WiFi and parking; reviews are mixed.
quote: Rue de la Verrerie, 5, 7330 Saint-Ghislain ... 55 guestrooms ... free WiFi, free parking ... mixed reviews ... falls short of expectations for a 3-star establishment

claim: Ferme de la Blanche Fontaine is a 3-room rural B&B in Ghlin (~3.7 km from Baudour), 9.1/10 on Booking with home-made breakfast; run by Ton & Ingrid Van Leeuwen.
quote: 3 comfortable, spacious, and luxurious guest rooms ... Ton and Ingrid Van Leeuwen offer an excellent breakfast composed exclusively of natural homemade products

claim: La Marelle in Blaregnies — the Fernez group's sister property — adds 5 more rooms plus a Bib Gourmand bistro; ~22 km south of Baudour, so it requires a car.
quote: five rooms at 'La Marelle' in Blaregnies ... flat-screen televisions and private bathrooms ... continental breakfast ... garden, free private parking

claim: Le Faitout, the Fernez family bistro that shares the Place de la Résistance address with d'Eugénie à Émilie, suffered a small fire in January 2026 and closed temporarily.
quote: Début d'incendie au Faitout à Baudour : Le restaurant temporairement fermé
